_comment: Editorial, time-invariant. Which near-Earth objects the map plots. Heroes are named singletons pulled by NORAD id; groups are CelesTrak catalogues pulled and capped to keep the JSON small and the client propagation cheap. Bands are informational; the true band is recomputed from mean motion at fetch time.

heroes.name: ISS
heroes.note: The International Space Station. Its signal reaches the ground below in about 1.4 milliseconds.

heroes.name: Tiangong
heroes.note: China's space station, crewed by Shenzhou missions.

heroes.name: Hubble
heroes.note: The Hubble Space Telescope, in low orbit since 1990.
